what_it_does: This chip accelerates hybrid CNN-Transformer models—neural networks that combine two different architectures to understand images at both local detail (via convolutional layers) and global context (via transformer attention). These models are used for semantic segmentation: marking which pixels belong to which object. The challenge is that transformer attention typically requires storing large matrices in memory—imagine a 16,000-row-by-16,000-column table of numbers representing relationships between every pixel. The chip uses three techniques to fit this in on-chip memory: first, it re-orders computations to skip unnecessary off-chip memory trips; second, it fuses multiple layers together to avoid repeated memory access; third, it removes unimportant weights and activations (pruning) at both the network's backbone and its final layer.
